description.value: Choices Market is a 100% BC-owned and operated natural and organic grocery chain that has anchored the Kitsilano neighbourhood since 1990. The store specialises in local, organic, and specialty food items—including thousands of Canadian-sourced products—making it a well-stocked resupply point for cyclists travelling through Vancouver's west side. An in-store Nutrition Team of Registered Dietitians offers free personalised consultations and guided store tours.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 28m; rack (3 spaces) at 33m; stands (1 space) at 34m; stands (3 spaces) at 51m; stands (4 spaces) at 51m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website Contact Us page explicitly confirms the Kitsilano location at 2627 West 16th Avenue, Vancouver, B.C. V6K 3C2 with phone (604) 736 0009, matching OSM exactly. The store is clearly a full-service natural and organic supermarket (Basic groceries confirmed). Neither the website content nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null per evidence-only rules.
concerns: The OSM website URL resolves to the chain's online shopping/Instacart ordering portal rather than a dedicated in-store location page; cyclist-specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, etc.) are not available from this URL.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, full-service natural and organic supermarket in a cycle-friendly Vancouver neighbourhood; clearly useful for touring cyclists needing a thorough grocery resupply.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wi-Fi is available for customers per OSM tags (SSID: SupportLocalChoices), which may be useful for route planning, though this was not confirmed via website content.
